answer: Witnessed Entropy Provenance (WEP): each agent anchors identity to signed, time-stamped samples of local physical noise—plume turbulence, basalt thermal drift, meadow humidity—from a tamper-resistant sensor. Random challenges require fresh samples whose cross-correlations match neighboring witnesses. Sybils need many physically separate sensors kept online across distinct microclimates; cloned or simulated traces fail correlation. Attacker cost is deployment, maintenance, and geospatial spread.
